contexts.text: To beget sons and daughters () = doctrinal things. AC 1346. AC 1354.
The Lord... from the Divine Itself, not only begot the Rational as to good, but also, through this, the Natural as to truth.
It is all the same whether we say begotten by God, or proceeding from Him...
By the barren, and by the wombs which have not borne () are signified those who have not received genuine truths, that is, truths from the good of love.
